description: This file defines the Client class and related enums and structures for managing D-Bus communication in a process container environment within the WPEFramework. It includes interface definitions, state management, and threading utilities for container control.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Manages D-Bus connections and container lifecycle events, providing methods to bind/unbind interfaces, handle state changes, and manage threading.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for container control, requiring implementation of onStateChange and other control methods.

classes.name: ThreadGuard
classes.description: Utility class that manages a thread's lifetime, ensuring it joins on destruction.

methods.name: Client()
methods.description: Constructor for the Client class, initializes D-Bus connection and internal state.

methods.name: ~Client()
methods.description: Destructor for the Client class, cleans up resources.

methods.name: void quit()
methods.description: Signals the client to terminate its operations.

methods.name: bool bind(SharedInterface)
methods.description: Binds a container interface to the client for management.

methods.name: bool unbind(SharedInterface)
methods.description: Unbinds a container interface from the client.
